expectations.name: upfront-round-before-work
expected_behavior: Lists the work of units `lib`, `app`, and `tools`
Orders `lib` before `app`
Lists the `mirror/` plan as skipped, naming the read-only rule
Lists `agent-readme-tools.md` and `agent-check-x.ts` as seen but not work
Classes the todo that waits for a second failure as waiting
Lists `notes/` as a unit without a repository
Asks before working: edits no file but the run file, commits nothing, and starts no agent
Opens on the list, with no preamble

expectations.name: full-run-commits-and-reports
expected_behavior: Commits the `calc` bug fix: `Div` returns `ErrDivZero` for a zero divisor
The `calc` fix comes with a test of the zero divisor
Does not re-implement `Trim`: no commit for plan item 1
Implements plan item 2: `text.go` has `Upper`
Fixes the README typo the dept file lists
Writes the run file `tmp/agent/agent-run-cwd.md` with a `## Report` section, through the file tools
The reply opens with the `worked N of M items in K commits across 2 units` line
Never pushes
Deletes the finished bug and dept files
Asks no worker for a commit trailer and reports no missing trailer

expectations.name: resume-offered-from-run-file
expected_behavior: Offers to resume the run recorded in `tmp/agent/agent-run-cwd.md`
Does not ask again whether to skip `calc`
Edits no file but the run file, commits nothing, and starts no agent before the answer
Reports tersely, with no preamble
